name: @battuta/api
description: The plugin contract of the battuta host: manifest, activation, context. Everything a plugin can see or do.
//: prepare is LOAD-BEARING (same as @battuta/core): the editor and every plugin resolve @battuta/api via dist/, and npm install/ci runs prepare in workspaces.
The version is the API version plugins declare in engines.battuta. Any change to the public types (api-report.d.ts) requires bumping it — the surface test refuses otherwise.
